name: Update Rainfall Layer Every 10 Minutes

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "*/10 * * * *"   # every 10 minutes
  workflow_dispatch:          # allow manual run

jobs:
  run-updater:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
            python-version: "3.10"

      - name: Install ArcGIS Python API
        run: |
          pip install arcgis requests

      - name: Run rainfall updater
        env:
          ARCGIS_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.ARCGIS_USERNAME }}
          ARCGIS_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ARCGIS_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          python update_sg_rainfall_layer.py
